correctness.rationale: For independent edge choices of weights p_i the three occupancy cases are exhaustive and disjoint, and their probabilities sum exactly to one. Conditional on two edge samples, the determinant has |U-V| times independent uniform opposite-edge height; conditional on three distinct sides it is R=UVW+(1-U)(1-V)(1-W). The displayed conditional coupling replaces U by 1-U, giving R in law as min((1-U)V,U(1-V))+|U-V|W and strictly greater tail at every t in (0,1). Differentiating 3(e2-3e3)A+6e3B along a two-coordinate equalization gives -3(p_i-p_j)^2[A(1-p_k)+2p_k(B-A)]<0, so majorization and both sharp envelopes follow, with triangle constraint 0<p_i<1/2 and unattained lower degeneracy. Beta integrals yield m1=e2/2,m2=e2/6,m3=3e2/40-e3/60; cubic x^3-x^2+e2 x-e3 has the unordered normalized side lengths as roots. Independently recomputed the first four component moments and exact mixture, inversion, and atom identities for multiple rational side vectors; no finite experiment substitutes for the analytic all-triangles conclusion.
residual_risks: Finite numerical corroboration is explicitly distinguished from the quantified analytic proof or exhaustive finite certificate.

value.rationale: The entire-perimeter arclength measure is intrinsic to triangle geometry and differs materially from a forced-one-point-per-side law. The exact distribution yields the globally sharp stochastic shape extremum and an inverse similarity theorem from only two specific area statistics, while showing why the first two moments fail. Researchers can use either the conditional law, the all-threshold comparison, or the explicit shape inversion as natural exact facts, rather than an arbitrary finite table.
residual_risks: Value assessment is mathematical usefulness of the precise new claim, not an assertion of broad downstream impact or publication prestige.

final_claim: For any nondegenerate Euclidean triangle, three independent entire-boundary arclength-uniform samples have normalized convex-hull area Z with exact occupancy mixture q0 delta_0 + q1 law(|U-V|W)+q2 law(UVW+(1-U)(1-V)(1-W)), q0=1-3e2+3e3, q1=3e2-9e3, q2=6e3. Its survival is strictly Schur-concave in sorted normalized side lengths; sharp bounds are attained at equal sides and approached at (1/2,1/2,0). The first and third moments uniquely recover the unordered side ratios via e2=2m1,e3=9m1-60m3.
limitations: Samples are iid uniform by total Euclidean boundary arclength, not conditional one per side or area-uniform; triangle nondegenerate, p_i<1/2. Reconstructs unlabeled normalized side ratios up to similarity, not scale. Lower stochastic envelope is limit, not attained. All novelty best-of-knowledge.
